symbol.content: def read_lanes(body: str) -> tuple[dict[str, str | None], list[str]]:     """Raw task-table Lane values keyed by Wnn; only valid empty cells yield None.     Malformed cells yield a row-specific problem and no value. Tables without a Lane column     supply no lane data; issue-format validation checks the table's required columns.     """     lanes: dict[str, str | None] = {}     problems = []     header: list[str] = []     for line in body.splitlines():         if not line.startswith('|'):             header = []             continue         raw = [cell.strip() for cell in line.strip().removeprefix('|').removesuffix('|').split('|')]         if not header and 'Task' in raw:             header = raw             continue         if not header or 'Lane' not in header:             continue         row = dict(zip(header, raw))         task = LINK.sub(r'\1', row.get('Task', ''))         ids = WID_SHAPED.findall(task)         if not ids or not task.startswith(ids[0]) or not WID.fullmatch(ids[0]):             continue         wid = ids[0]         if 'Lane' not in row:             problems.append(f'{wid}: missing Lane cell')             continue         lane = row['Lane']         if lane and not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', lane):             problems.append(f'{wid}: Lane must be a bare decimal index or empty; got {lane!r}')             continue         lanes[wid] = lane or None     return lanes, problems
